summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for incoming bot reviews (CodeRabbit, Copilot) and automatically resolve them as they arrive, then collect staging performance baselines before a vault migration lands.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads across 4 rounds were resolved with real fixes committed; staging perf baselines captured; auth/refresh + vault init race condition discovered, documented, and a fix branch created.

repo: Copilot and CodeRabbit sometimes post 'outside of diff range' comments in a review body that don't appear as resolvable GraphQL reviewThreads — these require manual PR comment replies rather than thread resolution
The old staging code never published vault key blobs to IPNS via the wallet login flow, only via test-login, so IPNS resolve returns 404 on staging for wallet-created vaults
Web3Auth Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time (~9-45s); cipher-box's own vault-critical path is under 1.5s
VaultBlobV2 type was removed — functions now return Uint8Array directly
TEE republishes IPNS records every 3h, making IPNS record expiry a non-issue for vault key blobs
The E2E tests use @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for real secp256k1 ECDSA signing in Playwright

code.finding: Bug: directRootIpnsName was derived as the vault key IPNS name but used as the root folder IPNS name for folder traversal — these must be derived separately

Bug: broad try/catch around getVault() + subsequent IPFS operations meant any IPFS 404 (missing CID) incorrectly triggered vault initialization for an existing user — getVault() needs its own isolated try/catch
After PR #349 merge, existing vault path resolves vault key IPNS name; if record not found throws 'Vault key IPNS name not found', caught by session restore, logs out Core Kit

Session restore calls setAccessToken() then immediately initializeOrLoadVault() — Zustand state update may not propagate before Axios interceptor picks it up; also multiple React effects fire on reload causing concurrent calls
Sequence-0 conflict on vault key IPNS publish now returns an error and aborts instead of warn-and-continue
slice() was used where subarray() is correct for zero-copy Uint8Array view

workflow: The /loop skill + CronCreate enables automated PR review monitoring — cron fires every 5 minutes, detects unresolved threads, and triggers /resolve-pr-reviews automatically
Cron jobs created via /loop auto-expire after 7 days; cancel early with CronDelete(jobId)

Playwright MCP sandbox doesn't support Node module imports (dynamic import fails) — standalone .mjs scripts run via Bash from within the package directory with proper node_modules resolution work instead
Playwright native page.on('request'/'response') events are more reliable for network monitoring than injecting fetch wrappers that don't survive navigation
gh api graphql reviewThreads with isResolved filter is the reliable way to count unresolved threads; REST reviews API misses some thread states

friction: GitHub API timed out on one poll cycle — transient, no action taken
7 new Copilot review comments didn't show up as unresolved GraphQL threads initially, requiring a separate fetch approach to discover them
Web3Auth OTP on staging is a real OTP, not a test bypass — can't use email login flow in Playwright for staging; had to switch to wallet mock approach
Playwright MCP browser_run_code can't import Node modules (dynamic import fails), requiring a workaround via standalone script + Bash
window.ethereum mock injected after page load is too late — Web3Auth initializes on load, so the provider must be injected via addInitScript before navigation
fetch monitoring via injected wrapper doesn't survive page navigation — native Playwright request events required
Staging DB was wiped so no existing vaults were present for IPNS resolve baseline measurements; had to create a vault via Playwright wallet login first
markdownlint failures blocked the first commit attempt on the perf baseline branch
open_items: Session restore race condition (two-layer): auth/refresh fires 6 concurrent calls on page reload; multiple successful refreshes each trigger initializeOrLoadVault() concurrently; both see getVault() 404 and both attempt vault init hitting UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns duplicate key constraint — fix branch fix/session-restore-race-conditions created, todo at .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-session-restore-race-conditions.md
Shared-Promise deduplication guard needed for both auth/refresh and initializeOrLoadVault() — fix not yet implemented, only documented
E2E test 3.7 (Page reload preserves session) is currently failing in CI due to the vault init race condition
Staging perf baselines need re-measurement after PR #349 deploys to capture real IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch numbers for an existing vault (script at tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs)
Core Kit session persistence across page reloads relies on tKey share caching in the browser — the mock wallet context doesn't persist this, so true session restore baseline couldn't be measured
Auth/refresh returns 401 for 2 of 6 concurrent calls on reload — pre-existing race visible in staging logs
